# Wolt

- Group / owner: DoorDash
- Homepage: https://wolt.com/en/discovery (uses the saved address).
- Search URL: `https://wolt.com/en/search?q=<name>` (Verified 2026-11-01, RO.) Results load lazily: scroll to the bottom, then match link text.
- Restaurant URL pattern: `https://wolt.com/en/<country-iso3>/<city>/restaurant/<slug>` (e.g. `/en/rou/bucharest/...`).
- Login signals: avatar/initials top-right = logged in; "Log in" / "Sign up" = logged out.
- Restaurant header: status ("Closed · Opens at 12:00"), min. order, delivery fee.
- Cart / checkout: basket button ("View order"); delivery and service fee in the order summary before payment. (To verify.)
- Subscription: Wolt+.
- Status: verified (RO, 2026-11-01) for search and restaurant page.
